records.public_safe_text: unit 1 and unit 2 were on the second level of the northwest parking garage of the listed location. unit 2 stated she observed a vehicle starting to reverse out of a parking space so she got out of the passenger side of the vehicle she was in to hold the parking space. the vehicle unit 2 was in drove forward to allow the vehicle to reverse out of the parking space and that vehicle was going to reverse into the parking space. unit 2 stated she stood by the parking space while the vehicle reversed out of the parking space. unit 2 stated she observed unit 1 driver begin to turn into the parking space. unit 2 stated unit 1 driver turned into the parking space and hit her right leg with the front left bumper. unit 2 stated she did bang on the driver side door and pushed unit 1 driver when she got out of the vehicle because unit 2 was upset. unit 2 had no visible injuries but did have dirt transfer on her right leg from the bumper. unit 2 requested ems. unit 1 driver stated when she pulled into the parking space, unit 2 was standing on the yellow line and she was not in the middle of the parking space. unit 1 driver stated she did not know she hit unit 2. on site security was on scene and they advised there was video surveillance of the incident. security stated video surveillance showed unit 1 turning into the parking space and unit 2 standing by the parking space. video surveillance showed unit 2 walking into unit 1 in an attempt to keep the driver from parking in the space. unit 2 was visibly upset cause unit 1 was parking in the space she was holding. i advised unit 2 to follow-up with tid. i gave both unit 1 driver and unit 2 the [case id]. coban/bwc available.
